title: Kernel and image of a constant-rank map on a reduced scheme
statement: Let $Y$ be a reduced scheme [def-pc-reduced-scheme], $M,N$ sheaves of modules on $Y$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and choose isomorphisms $M\simeq\mathcal O_Y^m$, $N\simeq\mathcal O_Y^n$ for natural numbers $m,n$ [def-weil-pbc-free-module]. Let $\varphi:M\to N$, let $j:Z\to Y$ be an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion], and let $a\in\mathbb N$. Suppose that for every $z\in Z$ there are a field $K$ and a morphism $g:\operatorname{Spec}K\to Y$ with image exactly $\{j(z)\}$ such that the matrix of $\varphi$ in the chosen bases has rank $a$ after evaluation along $g$ [def-weil-matrix-rank]. Write $\psi=j^*\varphi$ [def-pc-module-pullback]. Then $\ker\psi$ is finite locally free of rank $m-a$, and $\operatorname{im}\psi$ is finite locally free of rank $a$ [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module]. Here the image is the kernel of the cokernel map [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-module-cokernel-image]. For every $z\in Z$ there is an open neighbourhood $U$ of $z$ such that the restriction of $\operatorname{im}\psi\hookrightarrow j^*N$ admits an $\mathcal O_U$-linear retraction.

source.place: normal-form claim and local kernel/image splitting

proof.text: For each z choose a neighbourhood U_z and source/target block bases from [lem-pc-constant-rank-map-local-normal-form]. The sets U_z cover Z, since z belongs to its chosen U_z. These are only local bases, not kernel/image or local-freeness conclusions.

In the abelian category of modules on U_z put p=e_S.hom followed by snd, and i=inl followed by e_T.inv. Then p is a split epimorphism, i a split monomorphism and p followed by i equals the restricted map. Mathlib kernelIsIsoComp, kernelCompMono and kernelBiprodSndIso identify its kernel with the first source block. Mathlib image.isoStrongEpiMono and Abelian.imageIsoImage identify its image with the pivot block, with inclusion i. The map e_T.hom followed by fst and the image isomorphism is a retraction. This calculation is proved in Lean by the private helper kernel_image_of_block_form, without a hole.

Restriction along an open immersion preserves kernels and cokernels. Use PreservesKernel.iso and Abelian.PreservesImage.iso to identify the restrictions of the original kernel and image with those calculated on U_z. Use the compatibility PreservesImage.iso_hom_ι to transport the retraction to the restricted original image inclusion. The covering U_z and isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_of_restrict_iso_free give both rank claims [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module]. No quasi-coherent affine image or tilde/global sections calculation is needed.

lean.statement:
theorem kernel_image_pullback_of_constantRank
    {Y Z : Scheme.{u}} [IsReduced Y] {M N : Y.Modules} {m n : ℕ}
    (eM : M ≅ free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin m)))
    (eN : N ≅ free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin n)))
    (φ : M ⟶ N) (j : Z ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion j] (a : ℕ)
    (hrank : ∀ z : Z, ∃ (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (_ : IsField R) (g : Spec R ⟶ Y),
      Set.range g.base = {j.base z} ∧
      ((freeMatrix (eM.inv ≫ φ ≫ eN.hom)).map g.appTop).rank = a) :
    (kernel ((Modules.pullback j).map φ)).IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank (m - a) ∧
    (Abelian.image ((Modules.pullback j).map φ)).IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank a ∧
    ∀ z : Z, ∃ U : Z.Opens, z ∈ U ∧
      IsSplitMono ((restrictFunctor U.ι).map
        (Abelian.image.ι ((Modules.pullback j).map φ)))
